# The debug panel's race census: every living character, counted by race, plus the three
# invariants the phenotype system promises.
#
# Called by gen_debug_panel_gather_effect (generated by Emit/GuiWindows/DebugPanel.cs, which only
# writes the call on a map that ships this file set), so the Live tab's Races rows are current
# whenever the panel is on screen. Leaves its figures as variables on the character it runs on,
# like the rest of the gather.
#
# The invariants, and what a non-zero means:
#   gen_dbg_race_untagged     no race yet. Normal in small numbers: the engine invents courtiers and
#                             guests all year and the pulse reaches them yearly. Large or growing
#                             means some population the pulse never visits.
#   gen_dbg_race_conflict     two races at once (gen_has_conflicting_phenotype_trigger). Should be
#                             0; the yearly pulse sanitizes it.
#   gen_dbg_race_contradicts  trait human, ethnicity fantasy, not a mixed line
#                             (gen_phenotype_contradicts_genes_trigger). Should be 0 after the
#                             game-start reconcile.

gen_debug_race_census_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_human value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_gracile value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_sylvan value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_stocky value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_rough_hewn value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_towering value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_diminutive value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_dusk_adapted value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_horned value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_untagged value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_conflict value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_contradicts value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_from_gene value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_mixed_human value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_hornborn value = 0 }

	save_scope_as = gen_dbg_race_root

	every_living_character = {
		# One race each, in the same order gen_sanitize_phenotype_effect ranks them, so a doubled
		# character is counted once, under the race it would repair to. The doubled count is its
		# own row below.
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_gracile }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_gracile add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_sylvan }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_sylvan add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_stocky }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_stocky add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_rough_hewn }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_rough_hewn add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_towering }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_towering add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_diminutive }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_diminutive add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_dusk_adapted }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_dusk_adapted add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_horned }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_horned add = 1 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_trait = phenotype_human }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_human add = 1 } }
		}
		else = {
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_untagged add = 1 } }
		}

		if = {
			limit = { gen_has_conflicting_phenotype_trigger = yes }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_conflict add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { gen_phenotype_contradicts_genes_trigger = yes }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_contradicts add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_flag = gen_phenotype_from_gene }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_from_gene add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_character_flag = gen_phenotype_human }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_mixed_human add = 1 } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_trait = hornborn }
			scope:gen_dbg_race_root = { change_variable = { name = gen_dbg_race_hornborn add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}
